action: Trace the radiator fin from authored geometry through a Lamplighter wayfarer composition.

action: Generate a restrained radiator-metal surface and compare it on the actual slat material after renderer admission.
observation: The first post-admission material swap produced an incomplete 45-draw frame and cannot establish visual quality. A corrected comparison assigned the map before shader admission and drew all 46 assembly submissions. A deliberately magenta diagnostic confirmed both slat meshes use that material, but the generated detail is barely distinguishable at close and chase scales; the frame still reads as plain tan bars.
decision: Do not ship the additional texture on this evidence. The radiator needs a stronger construction and finish treatment rather than an imperceptible map.
next: Have an Astra modeler iterate the actual radiator and its fighter connection, preserving variant mounts and comparing total draw cost.
evidenceScope: Synthetic fighter assembly using compiled scratch parts and the game renderer; not a natural traffic encounter.
performance: Corrected comparisons draw 46 submissions; the proposed 512px map would introduce a distinct image. No gameplay timing claim.
